items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: when you studied with Mr. Chalier? ... Oh, he teached me this with a snare drum.

ctx.x: Can you tell us a little bit more about your life then, when you started telling us, when we interrupted you about your uncles, when you studied with Mr. Chalier? Okay. Anything else about your lessons? Did you just work on snare drum, or did you have a whole drum set? How did he teach?
